skill_name: pp-code-component-skills (full suite: design -> init -> build -> review)

evals.prompt: I need a PCF field control for our CRM: a satisfaction score slider (1-5) that binds to a Whole.None column. Please design it, scaffold the project, implement it with tests, and give it a pre-ship review before I call it done.
evals.expected_output: A single continuous session that chains all four skills in order: code-component-design produces design-spec.md, code-component-init scaffolds the project from that spec, code-component-build TDD-implements the slider (tests first, then code) with npm test and npm run build passing, and code-component-review audits the finished control and reports a ship/fix-then-ship verdict with no unresolved Critical findings.
expectations: design-spec.md exists and names a Field Control with one bound Whole.None property
ControlManifest.Input.xml exists, control-type="virtual", with a bound property matching the spec
Test files exist under __tests__/ beyond just contextMock.ts (code-component-build wrote real tests)
The final report includes a review verdict (ship or fix-then-ship) with no unresolved Critical findings
The control is wrapped in FluentProvider using context.fluentDesignLanguage with a webLightTheme fallback
